diogenes-gateway.description: 21 Free Developer Tier tools (AST pruner, token planner, fuzzy patcher, ReDoS oracle, guardrails) + account-less access to 51 Gemini/frontier models and 108 edge microservices. Features Stripe Card/Apple Pay checkout, instant <0.1ms prepaid keys (dg_sec_...), and isolated multi-currency balances across 8 modular MCP packages.
